CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_staff_shop_ids()
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select sh.id
  from public.staff s
  join public.shops sh on sh.business_id = s.business_id and sh.active
  where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
    and s.active
    and s.terminated_at is null
    and (
      s.role = 'owner'
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.staff_shops ss
        where ss.staff_id = s.id and ss.shop_id = sh.id
      )
    )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION followup_private.assert_customer(p_shop uuid, p_uid text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_uid IS NULL OR length(p_uid) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sync_records
    WHERE shop_id=p_shop AND table_name='accounts' AND row_uid=p_uid AND payload->>'category'='Customer') THEN
    RAISE SQLSTATE 'PT422' USING MESSAGE='followup_customer_missing';
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION followup_private.heads(p_shop uuid, p_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('sync',coalesce((SELECT max(server_seq) FROM public.sync_records WHERE shop_id=p_shop),0),
    'credit',coalesce((SELECT max(server_seq) FROM credit_private.records WHERE shop_id=p_shop),0),
    'metadata',coalesce((SELECT max(seq) FROM followup_private.actions WHERE shop_id=p_shop),0),
    'policy_revision',(SELECT revision FROM followup_private.policies WHERE shop_id=p_shop),'business_date',p_day)
$function$
